_: The demo video: one rumour followed from its arrival to the public. Each scene = a chapter card (chapter, title, caption), then steps played in the real app. setup (once, after sign-in) and before (per scene) prepare the demo through the API: find (a claim by title words, kept as {as}), patch (a claim, with a body), analyze (runs the AI analysis and waits), wait_indexed (waits for the sources to be searchable). Steps: goto (path, {ws} and found names are replaced; ready: a selector to wait for, clicking « Réessayer » if the page failed to load), click / hover (Playwright selector), type ([selector, text]), press (key), scroll (pixels), wait (ms), wait_for (selector, timeout ms), optional: true to skip a step whose element is missing. hold = ms kept on screen at the end. The rumour (Analakely, fictional) is the demo data's: swap it for the real story's. Film with: uv run --with playwright python -I scripts/pitch_video.py
